name: freeze-validation
note: The pre-freeze validation run (2026-10-03, owner-approved scope, about $100). Targets what no scored run has exercised yet: written-rule handling (qodo-rules30), Swift and XCTest (qodo-swift13), a Martian regression guard on the TUNING split (martian-tune20; test30 stays held out), and AACR dev10 with five of its PRs reviewed twice (dev10-rep5) for the run-to-run variance floor. No held-out set. Extended by freeze fixes 2 (same day, within the owner's 200-review budget): the PRs behind the misses the fixes target — rest145-miss8 (AACR rest145 PRs with the most medium/high missed defects), qodo-miss6 (Qodo PRs behind the vendor-caught functional misses, outside rules30/swift13) and sweprbench-miss2 (SWE-PRBench's two clear misses).
